_comment: Each Shadeborn's look by region (depths, flats, dunes, reaches) and role: skins are textures/entity/shadeborn/<name>.png, worn accessories are models/entity/shadeborn/<name>.json with textures/entity/shadeborn/<name>.png. A role's skins go before the region's; what is worn is both together. An entry may be {"model": name, "chance": 0.5}. See client/ShadebornVariants.
